sections.section_name: Section D - Application and Problem Solving

questions.question_text:
Sara goes to the Fun Fair. She buys a toy train for 25 Rupees and a candy floss for 15 Rupees. She gives a 50-Rupee note to the shopkeeper. 
a) What is the total cost of the items she bought? 
b) How much change will the shopkeeper give back to Sara?
questions.answer:
a) Total cost = 25 Rupees (toy train) + 15 Rupees (candy floss) = 40 Rupees. 
b) Change to be given back = 50 Rupees (note given) - 40 Rupees (total cost) = 10 Rupees.

questions.question_text:
The teacher made a tally chart of the favorite colors in Class 2. 
Red: 8 students
Blue: 12 students
Green: 5 students
a) Which color is liked by the most students? 
b) How many more students like Blue than Green? 
c) What is the total number of students who like Red and Blue?
questions.answer:
a) Blue is liked by the most students (12 students). 
b) 12 (Blue) - 5 (Green) = 7 more students like Blue. 
c) Total students who like Red and Blue = 8 (Red) + 12 (Blue) = 20 students.
